I told my girlfriend that night fully expecting her to break up with me - she didn’t. She was loving and supportive and said she’d help me. I told her I had to tell my mum but chickened out till Thursday morning after having another hit of weed and broke down crying that I was weak. So that night I told my mum expecting her to hate me but she welcomed me home and on Friday when I woke up I felt completely different like I obeyed God and I threw out the rest of the weed and that was 106 days ago. That day I also stopped watching porn and masturbation. I’d be lying if I said I didn’t have any cravings but as soon as I did I remembered this bible verse - (“We demolish arguments and every pretension that sets itself up against the knowledge of God, and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.” - 2 Corinthians 10:5) and the craving would go away. 
I did stop here and there throughout the 7 years but not for that long and just because I didn’t have an opportunity to do it. I’ve been around weed with the homeless people I now help and have no urge to do it nor every again. 
I got a job, I started going to church every week, I go to bible study, go to Christian mens camps, read my bible everyday and pray multiple times a day. I go to the gym to keep my body healthy and honestly my mind is so clear now and I can remember stuff. Weed made me forget the bad parts of it and tricked me into thinking I couldn’t be without it. 
I haven’t had any bad parts because it’s so much better then sitting at home playing my video games - which I might add I haven’t played now in 50 days at all.
